verdict.rationale: Render's own materials describe ephemeral previews of the entire application architecture for every change, and say every pull request gets its own running copy of the application stack. The full-stack scope rests on Blueprint YAML defining the whole architecture, and a related control keeps non-production environments away from production services. missing for 10: in-depth docs on preview lifecycle and teardown (expiry, datastore provisioning/seeding per PR), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request

citations.quote: Iterate quickly with ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change.
every pull request gets its own running copy of the application stack.
Define, deploy, and version your entire architecture with a single YAML file.
